summary.text: Christopher Wier is the Democratic candidate for Oklahoma House of Representatives District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican incumbent Bob Ed Culver.
A musician and community advocate from Stigler, he says he is running on rural education, health care and infrastructure.

paragraphs.text: Wier was born in McAlester, Oklahoma.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Stigler and described himself as a musician, an advocate and a community leader.
Wier's Democratic primary was canceled, and he advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.

He listed rural education, rural health care and rural infrastructure as his three campaign messages, and said that Cherokee County has a strong health care system but that this is not true for all Oklahomans.
